g.text: Matchmaking Hands Off To A Pinned Game Session
Two subsystems: a rating-bucketed pool that resolves in seconds, and a stateful game-server fleet that holds one board for the life of a game.
LIVE GAME SESSION -- lives for the whole game
per time control; bucketed by rating
atomic pair-and-remove resolves the race, not a lock
Both players' WebSocket connections are pinned to the SAME instance --
the deliberate exception to this guide's stateless-behind-a-load-balancer default.
Matchmaking is stateless and resolves in seconds; the Game Server fleet is stateful and holds one board for the life of a game.
Session Router is the seam between them -- the one deliberate exception to this guide's stateless-behind-a-load-balancer default.
